function.name: get_projects
function.description: List the user's known projects, most recently opened first. Returns projects, active project.

function.name: open_project
function.description: Open a project and make it the active one. Identify it by name, id, or path.

path.description: Filesystem path to a .temno or .palmier package.

function.name: new_project
function.description: Create a new project in the user's Temno folder and make it active.

template.description: Optional saved project template name. A name that is not a saved template fails without creating a project.

function.name: close_project
function.description: Save and close an open project. Omit all arguments to close the active project.

path.description: Filesystem path to a .temno or .palmier package.

function.name: manage_project
function.description: List, open, create, or close Temno projects for this MCP session. Set `action` to: `list` for known projects plus session-active and visible state; `open` with a name, id from list, or .temno/.palmier path; `create` with an optional name and initial fps/aspectRatio/quality; or `close` to save and close the session project, optionally targeting another open project by name/id/path. Opening or creating changes only this session's target. Closing always completes a final save first. This tool never deletes projects or files.

name.description: Project name. For open/close, matched case-insensitively; for create, defaults to 'Untitled Project'.

id.description: Project id returned by action='list'. Used by open or close.

path.description: Filesystem path to a .temno or .palmier package. Used by open or close.

fps.description: Create only. Optional timeline frame rate (1-120).

aspectRatio.description: Create only. Optional canvas aspect ratio.

quality.description: Create only. Optional resolution preset applied to the aspect ratio.

template.description: Create only. Optional saved project template name. A name that is not a saved template fails without creating a project.

function.name: get_timeline
function.description: Always call at the start of a session. Returns project settings, tracks and clips.

captionDetail.description: Optional. True expands captionGroups into per-clip rows.

function.name: inspect_timeline
function.description: See the composited timeline - what the user actually sees in the preview. With no frame given, it renders the playhead frame.

startFrame.description: Project frame to render. Omit it and endFrame to render the playhead frame, what the user sees now.

maxFrames.description: Frames to sample when endFrame is set.

function.name: validate_timeline
function.description: Pre-export safety scan of the active timeline - pure read-only inspection.

exportPresetId.description: Optional saved export preset id or name.

function.name: create_timeline
function.description: Creates a timeline and switches to it.

function.name: set_active_timeline
function.description: Switches the active timeline.

timelineId.description: Timeline id from get_media's timelines list.

function.name: set_project_settings
function.description: Change the project's frame rate, resolution, or aspect ratio.

fps.description: Frame rate in frames per second.

function.name: export_project
function.description: Exports from the current project: video (H.264/H.265/ProRes/HEVC HDR), FCPXML, XMEML (xml), or self-contained temno package (mode name `palmier` reads both, writes .temno).

outputPath.description: Optional destination. When omitted, a name not yet taken in ~/Downloads (<project>.<ext>, then <project> 2.<ext>, …). palmier mode adds .temno to a new package's path (a .palmier suffix becomes .temno) and replaces only an existing .temno or .palmier package that holds project.json: any other folder, a file or a link is refused. The other modes refuse a folder or a link. No mode writes inside a .temno or .palmier folder or the open project.

overwrite.description: Default true. false refuses when the destination already exists, judged after palmier mode adds .temno.

maxRenderQuality.description: video mode only. true sets a higher quality target on the software H.264 and H.265 encoders (x264, x265): CRF 18 instead of 23. No effect on hardware encoders (NVENC, QSV, AMF), OpenH264 or ProRes. By default a hardware encoder is used where one exists; pass preferHardware false for this to apply.

maxBitDepth.description: video mode only. true exports HEVC 10-bit tagged HLG, whatever codec says. The picture is rendered in 8-bit SDR and converted, not processed at higher precision.

preferHardware.description: video mode only. Overrides the saved prefer-hardware-encode preference; NVENC/QSV/AMF when true, software encoders when false.

background.description: video mode only. When true, queues the render and returns a jobId immediately; poll with manage_exports.

allowOfflineMedia.description: video mode only. Default false: a timeline whose picture would be missing clips because their media is offline is refused, and the error names them. true exports anyway, like the editor's Export anyway: those parts of the picture are left blank, offlineMedia lists each offline file with the frame ranges (end exclusive) that use it, and missingPicture lists the clips the render dropped. A timeline with no picture left is still refused.

function.name: manage_exports
function.description: List queued/running exports and their progress, or cancel one by jobId. An export queued with allowOfflineMedia also lists warnings, and missingPicture once it completes.

jobId.description: Required for cancel. A jobId from export_project (background) or manage_exports list.

function.name: add_marker
function.description: Adds a named marker to the active timeline at a given frame.

frame.description: Project frame to place the marker at.

function.name: list_markers
function.description: Lists every marker on the active timeline, sorted by frame.

function.name: update_marker
function.description: Updates one or more fields of an existing marker on the active timeline.

function.name: remove_marker
function.description: Deletes a marker from the active timeline.

function.name: add_transition
function.description: Adds a transition spanning the boundary of two adjacent clips on the same video track.

durationFrames.description: Length of the transition in project frames.

function.name: list_transitions
function.description: Lists every transition on the active timeline.

function.name: remove_transition
function.description: Deletes a transition from the active timeline.

function.name: get_media
function.description: The library inventory: media assets, folders, and timelines.

pending.description: Optional. True returns only pending assets.

function.name: inspect_media
function.description: Look at a media asset before referencing or editing it.

overview.description: One storyboard grid of distinct moments.

function.name: search_media
function.description: Search the media library by content: what's on screen (visual) and what's said (spoken).

function.name: import_media
function.description: Imports external media into the project's library. A local path is copied into the project by default, so the package stays self-contained; set source.reference true to record the file where it already is instead, which matters for very large sources. A url import, and the copy of a local file of 64 MB or more, run in the background and return {mediaRef, status:'downloading'}: poll get_media with ids:[mediaRef] until generationStatus clears ('failed: <reason>' means it did not land). Every other import finishes in the call and returns status:'ready'.

url.description: HTTPS URL. The type comes from mimeType when set, else from the URL path's extension; with neither, the download runs inside the call.

reference.description: Local path only. True records the file where it already is (media.json external.absolutePath) instead of copying it into the project. The project stays small and the import is instant, but it is no longer self-contained: move or delete the original and the asset goes offline. Defaults to false (copy).

path.description: Legacy absolute local path. Prefer source.path. Do not combine with source.

folderId.description: Legacy destination folder id. Prefer folder.

function.name: organize_media
function.description: Reorganizes the library in one undoable action.

function.name: manage_tracks
function.description: Track-level operations in one undoable action: reorder, set flags, and remove.

action.description: Legacy operation. Prefer reorder, set, and remove.

function.name: add_clips
function.description: Places one or more media assets on the timeline as a single undoable action. When a video asset with audio is placed on a video track, a linked audio clip is automatically created on an audio track (an existing one if available, otherwise a new one); the pair shares a link group and one undo removes both.

function.name: insert_clips
function.description: Inserts one or more media assets at a single point and RIPPLES. As in add_clips, a video asset with audio spawns a linked audio clip, and the push is applied to the audio track that clip lands on so the pair stays aligned.

function.name: move_clips
function.description: Moves one or more clips to a new track and/or frame position.

function.name: remove_clips
function.description: Removes one or more clips by ID.

function.name: restore_linked_audio
function.description: Repairs timelines built before linked-audio partners existed: for every listed video clip whose media has audio and which has no linked audio clip yet, creates the audio partner add_clips would have made (same occupancy rule, never overwrites, one undo). Clips that need nothing are reported as skipped with a reason.

function.name: split_clips
function.description: Splits clips into two at one or more cut points.

function.name: ripple_delete_ranges
function.description: Cuts one or more ranges out and closes the gaps in one undoable action. Give exactly one of clipId or trackIndex. Linked clips stay together: every clip the cut trims or moves takes its partners (a video clip's linked audio, a multicam group's other clips) with it, cut by the same frames on their tracks. If a partner's track holds an unrelated clip inside a range, nothing is cut and the error names that clip. Answers removedFrames.

trackIndex.description: Track index; ranges are project frames.

clipId.description: Clip ID; ranges are clamped to the clip.

ranges.description: Ranges to remove, each a [start, end] pair (end > start).

units.description: Ranges unit, default frames (project frames). seconds are the clip's source seconds and need clipId.

ignoreSyncLockedTracks.description: Accepted for Mac parity. Windows has no sync lock, so it has no effect.

function.name: set_clip_properties
function.description: Apply the same generic clip property values to one or more clips.

function.name: set_keyframes
function.description: Set animated keyframes on one property of one clip.

keyframes.description: Rows of [frame, ...values, interpolation?]; interpolation is linear, hold or smooth. An empty array clears the track.

function.name: apply_layout
function.description: Arrange multiple clips into a common multi-video layout (split screen, picture-in-picture, grid).

function.name: suggest_crop
function.description: Auto-reframe one clip for a different aspect ratio.

function.name: sync_clips
function.description: Align one or more clips to a reference clip by shifting targets on the timeline.

function.name: manage_multicam
function.description: Create or ungroup a multicam group. create syncs session media into stamped timeline clips; ungroup strips multicam stamps.

function.name: change_cam
function.description: Switch a multicam group's camera angle over timeline frame ranges. Full-frame: {range, angle}. Multi-angle layout: {range, layout, angles} places primary in the main slot and extras as overlays (side_by_side, pip_*, grid_2x2, …).

clipId.description: Any clip in the group (alternative to groupId).

layout.description: Multi-angle layout (not full). angleLabels fill slots in order.

items.description: angleLabel in slot order; first is program/main.

angles.description: Required with layout. Fewer than slots leaves cells empty.

function.name: get_multicam
function.description: Read a multicam group: members, program cut rows, and track indexes.

function.name: undo
function.description: Reverts the assistant's most recent timeline edit.

function.name: redo
function.description: Re-applies the assistant's most recently undone timeline edit.

function.name: get_transcript
function.description: Returns the spoken transcript of the CURRENT timeline in project frames (on-device Whisper; cached).

function.name: remove_words
function.description: Cut speech by the word, Descript-style.

function.name: remove_silence
function.description: Remove dead air - quiet, speech-free sections - from the timeline's audio.

function.name: detect_beats
function.description: Detect musical beats and downbeats in a media asset's audio, on-device.

function.name: add_texts
function.description: Adds text clips as timeline layers.

backgroundColor.description: Text box fill hex; enables fill.

function.name: update_text
function.description: Updates text clips or a captionGroupId.

backgroundColor.description: Text box fill hex; enables fill.

function.name: add_captions
function.description: Transcribes spoken audio with on-device Whisper and creates styled caption text clips.

censorProfanity.description: Rejected on Windows Whisper (Apple Speech only).

maximumGapSeconds.description: Close gaps up to this many seconds (0-2, default 0.5).

trackIndex.description: Caption only this track index instead of auto-detecting.

subtitleMediaRef.description: SRT/VTT library asset to place as captions. Cannot be combined with any other argument.

backgroundColor.description: Text box fill hex; enables fill.

function.name: apply_color
function.description: Author/refine a color grade on video/image clips with named controls.

function.name: apply_effect
function.description: Apply non-color effects to video/image clips. Optional effect position sets the final stack index; omitting it does not reorder an effect already on the clip.

position.description: Optional zero-based final index. Omit to keep an existing effect where it is, or to insert a new effect at its catalog position.

function.name: inspect_color
function.description: Measure color scopes of a timeline clip's current graded look.

function.name: denoise_audio
function.description: Apply deterministic Windows denoise to audio clips during shared preview/export decoding.

function.name: duck_audio
function.description: Writes attack/release volume envelopes on a background audio track under voice-clip coverage.

source.description: Only auto (voice-clip coverage) is currently supported.

function.name: list_models
function.description: Lists AI models with their capabilities.

function.name: generate_video
function.description: Starts an async AI video generation. It costs the user real money with a real provider (Temno credits when hosted, their own provider's bill on their key), so call it only after the user says yes to your proposal. Hosted generation is quote-only: call quote_media first, show its credits in the proposal, and pass its quoteId; the quote binds prompt, settings and inputs. BYOK and demo take the direct arguments.

prompt.description: Text description. Required for BYOK and demo; with a quoteId it may be omitted, or must match the quote.

duration.description: Duration in seconds (BYOK and demo; hosted durations are quote_media settings).

operation.description: Must match the quoted operation when given.

quoteId.description: Accepted quote_media id. Required for hosted generation.

maxCredits.description: Optional accepted spend cap; the submit fails when the quote exceeds it.

settings.description: Must match the quoted settings when given.

inputs.description: Must match the quoted inputs when given.

function.name: quote_media
function.description: Quotes a hosted video, audio, or upscale generation without spending. Pass the returned quoteId to generate_video, generate_audio, or upscale_media; any model, operation, prompt, settings, or input change needs a fresh quote. Free to cancel until rendering starts.

model.description: Hosted media model ID from list_models.

prompt.description: Text description. May be empty only for input-only operations.

settings.description: Temno option names to values; unknown names are rejected.

inputs.description: Ordered {role, mediaRef} inputs. Roles: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, source_video, source_audio.

function.name: generate_image
function.description: Starts an async AI image generation. It costs the user real money with a real provider (Temno credits when hosted, their own provider's bill on their key), so call it only after the user says yes to your proposal. Hosted generation is quote-only: call quote_image first, show its credits in the proposal, and pass its quoteId. BYOK and demo take the direct arguments.

prompt.description: Text description. Required for BYOK and demo; with a quoteId it may be omitted, or must match the quote.

settings.description: Hosted Temno option names to values; unknown names are rejected.

quoteId.description: Accepted quote_image id. Required for hosted generation.

maxCredits.description: Optional accepted spend cap; the submit fails when the quote exceeds it.

function.name: quote_image
function.description: Quotes a hosted image generation or edit without spending. Pass the returned quoteId to generate_image or edit_image; any prompt, model, operation, settings, or source change needs a fresh quote. Free to cancel until rendering starts.

model.description: Hosted image model ID from list_models.

settings.description: Temno option names to values; unknown names are rejected.

aspectRatio.description: Legacy alias for the aspect_ratio setting.

resolution.description: Legacy alias for the resolution setting.

quality.description: Legacy alias for the quality setting.

function.name: edit_image
function.description: Starts an async hosted AI image edit from a quote_image quote. It spends the user's Temno credits, so call it only after the user says yes to a proposal that showed the quote's credits. Edit needs at least one source image bound in the quote.

maxCredits.description: Optional accepted spend cap; the submit fails when the quote exceeds it.

prompt.description: Must match the quoted prompt when given.

model.description: Must match the quoted model when given.

settings.description: Must match the quoted settings when given.

maskMediaRef.description: Must match the quoted mask when given.

function.name: resume_generation
function.description: Resumes a hosted generation that is still pending, rendering, or recovering. It does not start a new job or spend again. Pass mediaRef to resume one placeholder; omit it to resume every unfinished generation for this account, including ones whose project is not open.

mediaRef.description: Placeholder asset id. Omit to resume every unfinished hosted generation.

function.name: generate_audio
function.description: Starts an async AI audio generation: text-to-speech, text-to-music, or video-to-music. It costs the user real money with a real provider (Temno credits when hosted, their own provider's bill on their key), so call it only after the user says yes to your proposal. Hosted generation is quote-only: call quote_media first, show its credits in the proposal, and pass its quoteId; the quote binds prompt, settings and inputs. BYOK and demo take the direct arguments.

operation.description: Must match the quoted operation when given.

duration.description: Length in seconds (BYOK and demo; hosted lengths are quote_media settings).

quoteId.description: Accepted quote_media id. Required for hosted generation.

maxCredits.description: Optional accepted spend cap; the submit fails when the quote exceeds it.

settings.description: Must match the quoted settings when given.

inputs.description: Must match the quoted inputs when given.

function.name: upscale_media
function.description: Upscales an existing video or image asset. It costs the user real money with a real provider (Temno credits when hosted, their own provider's bill on their key), so call it only after the user says yes to your proposal. Hosted generation is quote-only: call quote_media first, show its credits in the proposal, and pass its quoteId; mediaRef must then be the quoted source. BYOK and demo take the direct arguments.

mediaRef.description: Asset ID to upscale. Required for BYOK and demo; with a quoteId it may be omitted, or must be the quoted source.

operation.description: Must match the quoted operation when given.

quoteId.description: Accepted quote_media id. Required for hosted generation.

maxCredits.description: Optional accepted spend cap; the submit fails when the quote exceeds it.

settings.description: Must match the quoted settings when given.

inputs.description: Must match the quoted inputs when given.

function.name: generate_google
function.description: Windows alias for generate_image or generate_video on BYOK (Convex/HTTP) or demo generation; hosted generation uses quote_image or quote_media instead. Not a Google cloud generation API. On BYOK it bills the user's own provider, so call it only after the user says yes to your proposal.

function.description: Saves a named, reusable text style preset.

backgroundColor.description: Text box fill hex; enables fill.

maxRenderQuality.description: Higher quality target on the software H.264 and H.265 encoders (x264, x265) when bitrateMbps is not set: CRF 18 instead of 23. No effect on hardware encoders (NVENC, QSV, AMF), OpenH264 or ProRes.

maxBitDepth.description: Exports HEVC 10-bit tagged HLG, whatever codec says. The picture is rendered in 8-bit SDR and converted, not processed at higher precision.

function.name: list_export_presets

function.name: remove_export_preset
